name: Scam Call Protection
mech: Listens to the live call audio at the carrier's voice switch. Runs the transcript through a manipulation-tactics classifier in real time. Cross-checks who is actually calling against the carrier-verified caller ID.
uses: Eldercare scam interception; banking fraud prevention mid-call; romance-scam alerting
moat_note: Twilio sees only its own VoIP calls; cannot tap PSTN-to-PSTN media path. App-layer apps cannot insert into the call without 3-way bridging that drops fidelity.

name: Voice Verification
mech: Pulls a 3-second voice sample from the live call. Compares it against the subscriber's voiceprint, which the carrier built from years of legitimate call history. Confirms whether the speaker matches the registered account holder.
uses: Senior protection (cloned-voice grandparent scam); high-value transaction voice-gate; political deepfake defense
moat_note: No app vendor has lifetime call-history voiceprints. Carriers do.

name: Financial Fraud Monitor
mech: Streams the live call transcript. Tags any spoken credit card numbers, account numbers, CVVs, gift card serials, or wire instructions. Confirms the subscriber is the one speaking, not someone coercing them.
uses: Dementia-protection (spouse alerts); elder financial abuse; corporate wire fraud
moat_note: Requires live in-band media access — Twilio cannot tap PSTN; Truecaller has no media access at all.

name: Emergency Call Block
mech: Sends a hangup command through the carrier's call control to drop both sides of the call within half a second. Triggered only when the scam score crosses the threshold. Notifies the subscriber's enrolled emergency contact.
uses: Kill-switch on confirmed scam; coerced-elder protection; teen safety
moat_note: Only carriers can drop a live PSTN call. Apps can only mute the speaker on the user's device.

name: Link Screening
blocker: SMSC-level message interception at partner carrier
mech: Intercepts inbound text messages at the carrier's SMS center before they reach the device. Detonates any URLs in a sandbox and checks them against threat-intelligence feeds. Reputation-checks the sender's number.
uses: Banking phishing block; package-delivery scam SMS; teen scam protection
moat_note: Requires SMSC-level interception. Apps only see SMS post-delivery (iOS sandboxes them entirely).

name: Threat Isolation
blocker: PCRF slice control + 5G SA radio on partner network
mech: Moves the suspicious call or session onto a quarantine network slice that's separated from the subscriber's normal traffic. Turns on deep packet inspection and routes call media through a monitoring proxy.
uses: Suspicious-caller honeypotting; malware-suspect device containment
moat_note: PCRF + slicing is 5G core function; no app vendor has policy control.

name: Spam Blocker
blocker: Pre-ring routing control at partner S-CSCF
mech: Looks up the incoming number in the carrier's call-pattern database. Cross-references network-level robocall fingerprints. Blocks or diverts the call before the subscriber's phone ever rings.
uses: Robocall elimination; senior protection; SMB inbox hygiene
moat_note: Carrier-aggregated patterns beat any single-app dataset. Pre-ring blocking only possible network-side.

name: Who's Calling
mech: Looks up the caller's number in the carrier subscriber registry to get the registered name. Checks the subscriber's call history for prior contact. Flags any spoofing or recent SIM swap.
uses: Unknown-number identification; sales lead qualification; eldercare
moat_note: Truecaller has crowdsourced data + needs app install; carrier has authoritative HLR data without app.

name: Smart Call Screening
mech: Diverts the inbound call to a network-side AI before it reaches the subscriber's phone. The AI answers, asks who's calling and why, and only bridges the real ones through.
uses: Personal AI receptionist; SMB front desk; teen safety
moat_note: Apps require call-forwarding setup per device; carrier deploys instantly to all subscribers.

name: Intent Detection
mech: Transcribes the screening dialog. Classifies the caller's intent (emergency, sales, scam, personal, booking). Adjusts where the call routes based on the result.
uses: Receptionist routing; emergency triage; SMB lead routing
moat_note: Requires inline media tap during screening. App-layer can only post-hoc analyze recordings.

name: Caller Background Check
mech: Resolves the calling number to a registered identity using the cross-carrier number-portability registry. Enriches with public records, business registries, and sanctions lists. Reads the carrier-issued caller-verification level.
uses: SMB lead vetting; dating safety; financial-services KYC
moat_note: Authoritative MSISDN-to-identity binding only carriers can resolve.

name: Smart Routing
blocker: iFC rule injection at partner HSS
mech: Tells the carrier's call control where to send incoming calls based on who's calling, the time of day, and calendar state. Checks which device is currently idle. Confirms the routing rule applies to this caller.
uses: Multi-device household routing; SMB on-call rotation; family-line routing
moat_note: Network-side routing means no device app needed; apps require always-on background process.

name: Voicemail Digest
mech: Pulls voicemails from the carrier's voicemail platform. Transcribes and summarizes them. Pushes the digest to the subscriber as a text message.
uses: Eldercare; busy professional; SMB
moat_note: Voicemail platform is carrier-owned; visual voicemail apps only mirror, don't replace.

name: Priority Line
blocker: PCRF/PCF QoS control at partner carrier
mech: Tells the carrier's policy controller to assign the subscriber's voice traffic to a high-priority lane with guaranteed bandwidth. Prioritizes call setup signaling. Verifies the subscriber's device is on a 5G network that supports slicing.
uses: Telemedicine; first responder; executive critical calls
moat_note: QCI/slice control is carrier-only. Twilio cannot guarantee PSTN call quality.

name: SMS & WhatsApp
mech: Sends outbound texts from the carrier's SMS center as if the subscriber sent them, with no device required. Adds verified-sender attestation for RCS. Maintains one inbox across SMS, RCS, and OTT channels tied to the subscriber's identity.
uses: Multi-channel personal assistant; SMB customer comms
moat_note: Truecaller and apps cannot send SMS as subscriber identity from another device.

name: Wait on Hold for You
mech: Places an outbound call from the subscriber's real number so the receiving business sees a verified caller ID. Listens to the call audio to detect when a human picks up versus an IVR. Texts the subscriber to hand off the call.
uses: Customer service hold; insurance claims; benefits enrollment
moat_note: Apps must originate from VoIP and lose carrier ID; carriers can place call AS subscriber natively.

name: Skip the Phone Tree
mech: Places an outbound call from the subscriber's number. Sends DTMF tones at the carrier's session border controller based on detected IVR menus. Listens for menu prompts to map the tree.
uses: All hold/IVR use cases; medical billing; gov services
moat_note: DTMF + media tap requires SIP-level access. App workarounds break on regional IVRs.

name: Lower Your Bills
mech: Places the call from the subscriber's real number so the business sees the actual account holder. Presents full caller-verification attestation proving the subscriber authorized the agent. Runs negotiation policy against the live call transcript.
uses: Cable/internet/insurance/phone bill renegotiation
moat_note: Bill negotiation REQUIRES caller ID = account holder. App vendors cannot do this without 3-way conferencing the user in.

name: Cancel Anything
mech: Calls from the subscriber's real number. Passes the account-verification gate using one-time codes intercepted via the messaging primitive. Handles the retention loop with negotiation policy.
uses: Gym, subscription, insurance, telco cancellations
moat_note: Same as bill_negotiator — requires acting AS subscriber with verified identity, not via 3-way call.

name: Task Planner
mech: Transcribes the subscriber's voice dump into a structured task list. Sends SMS confirmations as work progresses. Logs every action against the subscriber's identity for audit.
uses: Personal productivity; SMB ops
moat_note: Identity-bound action ledger requires carrier-anchored auth.

name: Dispute a Charge
mech: Calls the bank from the subscriber's real number. Passes the bank's voice-biometric gate because the caller ID and attestation are real. Runs the dispute script.
uses: Credit card disputes; bank charge reversals
moat_note: Banks reject calls that don't pass caller-ID + voice-bio. App vendors fail this gate.

name: Get Your Refund
mech: Calls the merchant from the subscriber's real number. Negotiates with customer service live. Follows up by SMS if the call doesn't close it.
uses: Consumer refunds; subscription cancellations
moat_note: Same — caller ID = account holder is mandatory at most CS lines.

name: Invoice Follow-Up
mech: Calls the debtor from the SMB owner's real business number so the client recognizes who's calling. Presents the registered-business attestation so it doesn't display as spam. Falls back to SMS if no answer.
uses: SMB collections; freelancer invoices
moat_note: Display-name + verified-caller-as-business is carrier function (RCS Business Messaging + STIR).

name: Persistent Follow-Up
mech: Schedules recurring outbound calls from the subscriber's number on a defined cadence. Only attempts when the destination is reachable. Falls back to SMS after a set number of voice attempts.
uses: Sales follow-up; collections; medical compliance
moat_note: Presence (reachability) data is carrier-only; cuts wasted attempt rate substantially.

name: Get Multiple Quotes
mech: Originates multiple parallel outbound calls from the subscriber's number. Transcribes each leg live and extracts comparable structured quotes. The subscriber-as-caller identity means vendors return real prices, not lead-form prices.
uses: Home services; insurance; medical procedures
moat_note: Parallel outbound at carrier scale; apps would hit per-account rate limits or VoIP blocks.

name: Find Who's Available
mech: Calls each candidate from the subscriber's number. Extracts availability slots from the response. Sends an SMS confirmation to the chosen vendor.
uses: Restaurant booking; doctor/dentist; contractors
moat_note: Caller ID = subscriber matters because some businesses block VoIP/anonymous numbers.

name: Compare Prices
mech: Places parallel outbound calls from the subscriber's number. Extracts prices from each call's transcript. Subscriber identity prevents vendor anti-bot rejection so the prices are real.
uses: Insurance shopping; service shopping
moat_note: Same as multi_quote.

name: Call Transcription
mech: Taps both sides of any call the subscriber is on at the carrier's session border controller. Runs speech recognition with speaker labeling. Binds the transcript to the subscriber's identity for access control.
uses: All call-history use cases; CRM ingestion; medical records
moat_note: Network-side capture works for PSTN, VoIP, mobile uniformly. Apps only capture VoIP or device-side recordings (with notification).

name: Call Notes & Digest
mech: Takes the captured call audio and transcript. Summarizes with action items extracted. Pushes the digest by SMS or RCS.
uses: Sales CRM; eldercare family briefing; medical
moat_note: Carrier-side capture means no microphone permission, no battery drain, works across devices.

name: Doctor Call Summary
mech: Captures the call with the doctor. Summarizes in medical-domain terms with terminology, dosing, and next steps. Shares with the subscriber and any designated family.
uses: Eldercare; chronic disease management; pediatric
moat_note: Capturing the FAR end of the call (doctor's voice) requires network tap. Phone apps only get the user's mic.

name: Live Translation
blocker: SBC media injection at partner SBC
mech: Taps both call legs in real time. Runs speech recognition, translation, and text-to-speech, then injects the translated audio back into the call. Uses a network slice to keep round-trip latency under 200ms.
uses: Cross-border family calls; ESL healthcare; SMB international sales
moat_note: Real-time injection back into PSTN media path requires SBC-level access. Apps cannot insert audio into PSTN call.

name: HD Voice Slice
blocker: PCF codec policy at partner 5G core
mech: Tells the policy controller to assign the call a wideband codec on a dedicated bearer. Negotiates full-band audio at call setup. Confirms the device is on 5G or VoLTE so slicing works.
uses: Medical telephony; live translation; coaching
moat_note: QoS + codec selection at call setup is IMS-only. OTT apps cannot influence PSTN codec.

name: Live Coaching
mech: Listens one-way to the subscriber's live call. Whispers prompts that only the subscriber can hear. Uses a network slice to keep prompt latency under 300ms so coaching feels real-time.
uses: Sales coaching; difficult conversations; negotiations
moat_note: One-way whisper-channel injection only carriers can do at PSTN layer. Apps require headset trickery.

name: Live Trust Score
mech: Combines caller attestation, line age, and number portability for an identity score. Adds real-time call-pattern and voice-deepfake scoring. Surfaces the result to the subscriber as a whisper or visual overlay.
uses: High-stakes calls; eldercare; financial
moat_note: Combining attestation + voice-bio + behavior in real time is multi-primitive — no app has all three.

name: Date Coaching
mech: Taps the call audio. Generates conversational prompts in dating context, delivered via whisper channel. Restricts access to the subscriber only.
uses: Consumer dating; social-anxiety support
moat_note: Same whisper-channel requirement; carrier-only.

name: Daily Check-In
mech: Polls the device's network state and last activity timestamps to see if the phone has been used in 24 hours. Places an outbound check-in call from a familiar family number. Falls back to SMS if no answer.
uses: Eldercare; living alone; recovery monitoring
moat_note: Network-level inactivity signals (no calls, no data, no SMS) only carriers see — apps can't tell you if the OTHER person's phone is dead.

name: 911 Family Alert
blocker: MSC emergency-call event feed + GMLC access
mech: Receives a real-time event from the carrier's mobile switching center the moment the subscriber dials 911. Pulls the network-derived location at the moment of the dial. Pushes alerts to enrolled family contacts.
uses: Eldercare; teen safety; chronic-condition
moat_note: 911 call event + GMLC location is core network telemetry. Apps cannot intercept 911 dialing.

name: Isolation Watch
mech: Maintains a 28-day rolling baseline of the subscriber's call and SMS volume. Counts outbound calls per day. Flags anomalous drops from baseline (e.g., zero outbound for five days when the norm is twelve per day).
uses: Eldercare; mental health; recovery
moat_note: Network-level CDR baseline is carrier-exclusive.

name: Behavior Change Alerts
mech: Monitors call duration, response latency, and time-of-day shifts. With consent, analyzes in-call speech for confusion or hesitation markers. Flags deviations from a 90-day baseline.
uses: Cognitive decline early detection; depression monitoring
moat_note: Cross-call behavioral baseline only carriers can build.

name: Restricted Line
blocker: S-CSCF policy rules at partner carrier
mech: Sets a carrier policy that allows inbound and outbound calls only to a defined whitelist. Applies the same whitelist to SMS at the SMS center. Optionally restricts data destinations and bandwidth.
uses: Child first phone; dementia patient; recovery support
moat_note: Network-level allowlist with carrier enforcement. Parental-control apps depend on the user not uninstalling.

name: Daily Brief
mech: Compiles a daily summary of the subscriber's phone activity, who called when. Adds call-history summarization. Sends to family via email or SMS.
uses: Eldercare; remote family; care coordination
moat_note: Activity log spanning all channels (voice/SMS/data) only at carrier.

name: Chat Companion
mech: Places outbound conversational calls as a consistent companion persona. Maintains an SMS thread between calls. Uses a stable persona phone number across sessions for relational continuity.
uses: Senior loneliness; mental wellness
moat_note: Persistent persona MSISDN + cross-channel state requires carrier-anchored identity.

name: Community Match
mech: Matches subscribers by interest profile from an opted-in directory. Brokers an introduction call between matched numbers without exposing them to each other. Optionally filters by proximity.
uses: Senior community; new-mover networking
moat_note: Cross-subscriber matchmaking + number masking is carrier function.

name: Book a Doctor
mech: Calls the provider from the subscriber's real number. Presents the insurance member ID via carrier-bound auth so it passes the provider's gate. Sends an SMS confirmation to the subscriber.
uses: Healthcare access; SDOH; eldercare
moat_note: Caller ID + insurance ID together is carrier-mediated trust chain.

name: Refill Prescriptions
mech: Calls the pharmacy IVR from the subscriber's real number. Sends DTMF tones for the Rx number and date of birth. Forwards the pharmacy's ready-text to the subscriber.
uses: Chronic care; eldercare
moat_note: Pharmacy IVR auth requires real subscriber caller ID.

name: Insurance Check
blocker: Carrier-bound auth for insurer voice-bio gate
mech: Calls the insurer from the subscriber's real number. Passes the insurer's voice-biometric gate because the caller ID and attestation are real. Extracts coverage details from the response.
uses: Pre-visit eligibility; surprise-bill prevention
moat_note: Insurer voice-bio gates only pass with real subscriber identity.

name: Care Team Sharing
mech: Issues subscriber-authorized access tokens scoped to specific family members or clinicians. Distributes call summaries to authorized recipients via SMS. Audits every share.
uses: Eldercare; chronic disease; pediatric
moat_note: Identity-bound consent + audit chain only at carrier auth layer.

name: Family Task Sharing
mech: Binds tasks to a family-group identity. Notifies assignees by SMS. Escalates by phone call if SMS goes unread.
uses: Multi-sibling eldercare; co-parenting
moat_note: Group identity + multi-channel escalation requires carrier-side identity graph.

name: Urgency Triage
mech: AI answers the business inbound and transcribes the caller's statement. Classifies urgency (emergency vs. quote vs. sales). Routes based on urgency to owner, voicemail, or next-day callback.
uses: Plumbers, HVAC, locksmiths, vets
moat_note: Pre-ring intent detection only at network IVR layer.

name: Book and Dispatch
mech: Calls the customer back from the registered business number to confirm. Sends SMS with ETA and the assigned tech's name. Business attestation ensures the call doesn't display as spam.
uses: Field services; trade SMBs
moat_note: Business-as-caller display requires registered business + carrier attestation.

name: After-Hours Answering
mech: Sets a time-based routing rule at the carrier's call control to divert after-hours calls to AI. AI captures intent and produces a structured message. SMS the owner with summary and escalate if urgent.
uses: Trade SMBs; clinics; legal
moat_note: Time-based routing at S-CSCF, not at device. App receptionists fail when phone is off.

name: Appointment Reminders
mech: Calls clients from the registered business number so they recognize who's calling. SMS reminder as fallback. Only attempts when the customer is reachable to avoid wasted outreach.
uses: Healthcare; salons; trades
moat_note: Caller-ID-as-business + presence-aware = lower no-show rate.

name: Separate Business Line
mech: Provisions a second phone number bound to the same SIM or eSIM. Each line has distinct caller-verification attestation for business vs. personal routing. SMS inboxes are kept separate.
uses: Sole proprietors; consultants; freelancers
moat_note: Multi-line on single SIM is carrier provisioning. App "second line" services lose attestation.

name: SIM Swap Protection
blocker: SIM-swap event feed from partner HSS
mech: Queries the carrier's SIM-swap event log. Alerts in real time on any IMSI change for high-risk subscribers. Notifies the subscriber and paired apps via a secondary channel.
uses: Crypto custody; banking; high-net-worth
moat_note: SIM-swap event ledger is carrier-internal. Apps can only react after the swap, not block it.

name: Verification Codes
mech: Intercepts inbound OTP texts at the SMS center before delivery. Verifies the OTP came from the claimed sender (e.g., a real bank short code). Releases the OTP only to the authorized agent context.
uses: Agent-driven workflows requiring 2FA; bill negotiation; account access
moat_note: SMS OTP interception at SMSC level, not via SIM toolkit. Apps need SMS read permission and still see post-delivery.

name: Identity Verification
mech: Queries the carrier subscriber registry for the IMSI-to-number binding. Confirms recent SIM-swap clean and line age. Adds the caller-verification attestation level.
uses: KYC; bill negotiation; account recovery; gov services
moat_note: Authoritative identity resolution requires HLR/HSS access — carrier-only.

name: Act As You
mech: Outbound calls present the subscriber's number as the verified caller ID. Full caller-verification attestation proves the subscriber authorized the agent. Outbound SMS sends from the subscriber's number with no device required.
uses: Universal — every concierge/SMB/healthcare agent uses this
moat_note: THE foundational primitive. Apps cannot present subscriber MSISDN with full attestation. This is the carrier moat.

name: Activity Log
mech: Binds every agent action to the subscriber's number and the specific agent ID for an audit trail. Includes call recording links as evidence. Includes message archive links.
uses: Compliance; dispute resolution; family transparency
moat_note: Network-side ledger is tamper-evident; app logs live on device.

name: Agent Permissions
mech: Subscriber defines per-agent scopes (read-only, book-only, spend cap) enforced at the network. Tokens issued and revocable in seconds, tied to the subscriber's number. Calls and SMS get gated by scope.
uses: Agent governance for all categories
moat_note: Network-enforced scopes survive even if device is lost; app-layer scopes die with the app.

name: E-Signatures
mech: Captures verbal agreement from the in-call audio with timestamp. Binds it to the verified subscriber identity so it's legally attributable. Sends a follow-up signature link by SMS.
uses: SMB contracts; consumer service agreements; consent capture
moat_note: Voice + identity binding makes verbal agreements enforceable. Apps cannot bind voice to verified MSISDN.

name: Secure Auth Slice
mech: Assigns OTP and authentication traffic to an encrypted, isolated network slice. Deep packet inspection and encryption guarantees on the slice. OTP texts route exclusively over the slice.
uses: Banking; gov; healthcare auth flows
moat_note: Network slicing is 5G core, carrier-only.

name: Make a call with an objective
mech: Originates an outbound call as the subscriber via the carrier's IMS. Adds caller-verification attestation. Runs a live ASR plus LLM dialog policy aimed at the objective.
uses: Foundational — any outbound agent task
moat_note: Outbound AS subscriber with attestation is carrier-only.

name: Screen inbound calls at the network
blocker: S-CSCF pre-ring intercept at partner carrier
mech: Intercepts the inbound call at the carrier's call control before it rings. Verifies and scores the caller. Diverts, answers with AI, or drops based on policy.
uses: Foundational — all screening agents
moat_note: Pre-ring control only at IMS S-CSCF. App-side cannot intervene before ring.

name: Whisper into a live call
blocker: SBC media injection at partner SBC
mech: Taps the live call media for bidirectional access. Mixes whisper-channel audio audible only to the subscriber's side. Network slice keeps coaching latency real-time.
uses: Coaching, translation, trust-score overlay
moat_note: Per-leg media injection at SBC. Apps cannot do this on PSTN calls.

name: Allocate a network slice
blocker: NSSF slice control at partner 5G core
mech: Assigns the subscriber to a named slice (emergency, HD-voice, secure-auth, etc.). Confirms 5G eligibility. Bounds the slice to a geographic coverage zone.
uses: Emergencies, HD voice, telemedicine, secure auth
moat_note: 5G core function. Carrier-only.

name: Monitor a line for anomalies
mech: Continuous CDR and activity monitoring builds a behavior baseline. Anomaly detection on volume, destination, and time-of-day. Flags IMSI changes and sudden location jumps as account-takeover signals.
uses: Eldercare; security; account protection
moat_note: Cross-channel CDR monitoring requires carrier data feed.

name: Real-time threat detection
mech: Streams the live call transcript. Runs multi-model scoring (scam plus deepfake plus financial-PII). Triggers downstream skills like terminate, alert, or isolate.
uses: Foundational — orchestrates protect-class skills
moat_note: Multi-primitive composite scoring with sub-second latency only feasible at network.

name: Schedule Future QoS Window
blocker: PCF scheduling API at partner 5G core
mech: Reserves a high-quality network window in advance for a planned event (telemedicine appointment, live broadcast). Confirms the subscriber will be on a 5G-capable network at that time. Notifies them when the slice activates.
uses: Scheduled telehealth visits; live event broadcast; planned remote-surgery prep
moat_note: Future-window QoS booking is 5G core (PCF) function. CPaaS has no scheduling primitive against the radio.

name: Zero-Rate App Traffic
blocker: OCS billing integration at partner carrier
mech: Tells the carrier's policy and charging system to not count traffic to a specific app against the subscriber's data cap. The cost is billed to the app developer instead. Tracks zero-rated bytes separately for reconciliation.
uses: Healthcare app on Medicaid sponsorship; field-worker tools; emergency-services apps
moat_note: Sponsored data is OCS+PCRF function. Apps cannot influence carrier billing.

name: Steer Traffic to Edge
blocker: UPF steering rules at partner 5G core
mech: Tells the carrier's data plane to route a specific app's traffic to the closest edge compute node instead of the public internet. Picks the best edge based on the subscriber's current cell. Falls back to cloud if the edge is unreachable.
uses: AR/VR; cloud gaming; real-time AI inference; remote control
moat_note: Traffic steering at UPF is 5G core only. CDN/edge providers can't steer at the radio level.

name: Historical Connectivity Quality
mech: Pulls historical network quality metrics for the subscriber from OSS analytics. Joins them with cell coverage maps to show where service is poor. Highlights recurring problem windows.
uses: Customer churn prediction; SLA reporting; coverage complaints
moat_note: OSS data is carrier-internal. Speedtest only sees what the user runs.

name: Forecast Coverage on Route
mech: Uses 5G core analytics to forecast network quality along a planned route. Returns expected throughput and signal strength per segment. Predicts where the subscriber will lose signal.
uses: Pre-trip route planning; logistics dispatch; field-service routing
moat_note: NWDAF is 5G analytics function — carrier-only. Map apps cannot predict signal.

name: Real-Time Data Usage
mech: Reads the subscriber's live data usage from the carrier's online charging system. Compares against their cap policy. Pushes a warning text at configurable thresholds.
uses: Family plan management; IoT fleet monitoring; B2B enterprise reporting
moat_note: OCS real-time counter is carrier-only. App-layer sees only its own bytes.

name: Find Nearest Edge
mech: Asks the MEC orchestrator for the closest edge compute node. Ranks candidates by latency and current load. Confirms the chosen node is healthy.
uses: Cloud gaming; AR/VR; real-time AI; industrial control
moat_note: MEC orchestrator visibility into RAN-attached compute is carrier-only.

name: Provision Private Slice
mech: Carves out a private 5G slice for an enterprise customer with isolation guarantees. Binds it to a tenant identity. Provides cryptographic proof the slice is isolated from public traffic.
uses: Manufacturing; ports; mining; hospital campus; private 5G
moat_note: NSSF slice provisioning is 5G core. No CPaaS player operates 5G core.

name: Carrier-Managed VPN
mech: Provisions an encrypted tunnel from the subscriber's line to a customer's cloud, managed by the carrier. Rotates keys automatically. Tied to the subscriber's identity, not a device app.
uses: Remote workforce; field engineers; secure healthcare access
moat_note: Carrier-anchored VPN survives device wipes; app VPNs require install.

name: Throttle Subscriber Bandwidth
mech: Tells the carrier's policy controller to cap the subscriber's bandwidth on a schedule (e.g., bedtime throttle). Enforced at the network, not on the device, so it can't be uninstalled.
uses: Parental controls; corporate device policy; rehab/recovery support
moat_note: PCRF-enforced. Parental-control apps depend on device-side enforcement that kids bypass.

name: Verify Device Near Coordinates
mech: A cheap fraud-gating call: gives the carrier coordinates and a radius and gets back a yes/no. Doesn't reveal the actual location, just confirms presence. Cross-references with the claimed transaction location.
uses: Card-present fraud gating; gig-worker verification; insurance check-in
moat_note: Network-derived location works without GPS or app install. Fraud-grade.

name: Geofence Crossing Alerts
blocker: GMLC event subscription at partner carrier
mech: Subscribes to live location updates from the carrier's location server. Fires an event when the subscriber crosses a defined boundary. Pushes alerts to enrolled recipients.
uses: Child safety (left school); eldercare (wandering); fleet management
moat_note: Network-side geofencing works on any phone without app install. Life360 requires install + battery.

name: Location Visit History
blocker: GMLC analytics feed with consent framework
mech: Asks the carrier whether the subscriber visited a specific area within a time range. Always consent-bound. Useful for correlating with reported events like crimes or accidents.
uses: Insurance claim validation; legal alibi; contact tracing
moat_note: Network-derived visit history is authoritative; app-derived can be spoofed.

name: Top Dwell Locations
mech: Computes the subscriber's top dwell locations (home, work, frequents). Used as a fraud baseline: a transaction at an unusual location flags as anomalous.
uses: Fraud baselining; lifestyle analytics; advertising targeting
moat_note: Cross-day location pattern from network signaling — apps drain battery and miss most of it.

name: Region Device Count
mech: Counts how many subscribers are in a polygon at a moment in time. Fully aggregated, no individual identities. Useful for foot-traffic analytics and event sizing.
uses: Retail foot traffic; event attendance; urban planning; emergency response
moat_note: Aggregated subscriber count across all devices is carrier-only.

name: Find Subscribers Nearby
mech: Finds opted-in subscribers within a radius of the user. Returns anonymized IDs, not phone numbers. Brokers a bridged call between matches without exposing numbers to either side.
uses: Community/dating; emergency-response volunteer match; lost-pet network
moat_note: Cross-subscriber location queries with number masking only at carrier.

name: Verified Device Identity
blocker: EIR query access at partner carrier
mech: Looks up the device IMEI bound to the subscriber's number. Returns make, model, and registration history. Checks against the stolen-device blacklist.
uses: Insurance verification; device-resale fraud check; warranty
moat_note: EIR is carrier registry. Apps cannot read IMEI on iOS at all.

name: Detect Cloned Device
mech: Checks the carrier's equipment registry for duplicate IMEIs across the network. Cross-references the inter-carrier clone registry. Binds the result to the subscriber for audit.
uses: High-value account protection; corporate device fleet integrity
moat_note: Cross-network IMEI uniqueness check is GSMA-level, carrier-only.

name: Remote eSIM Provisioning
blocker: SM-DP+ API credentials at eSIM host
mech: Pushes an eSIM profile to a target device using the carrier's remote SIM provisioning system. Activates the new MSISDN at the subscriber registry. Confirms with a test call or SMS.
uses: Travel eSIM; instant device swap; teen first-phone setup; lost-device replacement
moat_note: SM-DP+/SM-SR is carrier infrastructure. App vendors can't issue SIM profiles.

name: Kill eSIM Remotely
blocker: SM-SR API + HSS suspend at partner carrier
mech: Revokes the eSIM profile from a lost or stolen device. Suspends service at the subscriber registry. Notifies the subscriber via a backup channel (email or partner phone).
uses: Lost/stolen device; corporate offboarding; child-handover
moat_note: Killing the SIM credential, not the session. Apps can only sign out a session.

name: Remote Camera Activation
blocker: OMA-DM/MDM channel on partner device fleet
mech: Activates a camera on an enrolled device (grandma's tablet, kid's watch) via the carrier's device-management channel. Requires pre-enrolled consent and emergency-context authorization. Family is notified the moment it activates.
uses: Eldercare emergency check; teen safety; lost-device recovery
moat_note: Carrier-side device control survives app uninstall and device lock.

name: Remote Device Lock
mech: Pushes a lock command to the device through the carrier's management channel. Marks the device as locked in the equipment registry so it can't be re-activated on another carrier. Logs location at the moment of locking.
uses: Lost/stolen device; corporate offboarding
moat_note: EIR cross-carrier lock means thieves can't just pop in a different SIM.

name: IoT Fleet Lifecycle
blocker: BSS bulk-provisioning API at partner carrier
mech: Manages an enterprise IoT fleet at scale: activate, suspend, or terminate SIMs in bulk. Applies fleet-wide policy templates for data caps and geographic restrictions. Reports real-time status per device.
uses: IoT enterprise; logistics fleet; smart-city sensors
moat_note: Bulk SIM lifecycle is carrier BSS function. No app substitute.

name: Charge to Mobile Bill
blocker: OCS billing integration + silent network auth
mech: Charges a purchase to the subscriber's monthly mobile bill instead of a credit card. Requires carrier-bound authentication that can't be phished. Sends an SMS receipt.
uses: App purchases (vs Apple/Google 30%); donations; micropayments
moat_note: Direct-to-bill is carrier billing relationship. Stripe/Apple cannot bill to mobile carrier.

name: KYC PII Match
blocker: BSS KYC data access at partner carrier
mech: Submits a customer's PII (name, address, DOB) and gets back a match score against what the carrier has on file. Combines with line tenure and SIM-swap status for a composite score.
uses: Banking onboarding; gov benefits; lending KYC
moat_note: Carrier subscriber-of-record is authoritative PII source.

name: Pre-Fill Forms
blocker: BSS KYC data access + consent framework
mech: Returns the subscriber's PII to pre-fill forms after consent. Token is time-bound and scoped. Every disclosure is logged for audit.
uses: Account opening; gov forms; insurance applications
moat_note: Authoritative pre-fill from carrier of record. Reduces account-opening drop-off.

name: Age Verification
blocker: BSS DOB query at partner carrier
mech: Returns a simple yes/no: is the subscriber over the age threshold? No date of birth disclosed. Privacy-preserving by design and consent-bound.
uses: Adult content; alcohol delivery; gambling; age-gated apps
moat_note: Carrier-of-record DOB is authoritative + privacy-preserving. Massive regulatory tailwind (UK/EU/US age-verification laws).

name: Voice OTP Delivery
mech: Delivers a one-time code as a voice call instead of an SMS. The voice call carries cryptographic attestation so it can't be phished. Useful for accessibility and SMS-fraud-resistant flows.
uses: Accessibility (visually impaired); SMS-fraud-resistant 2FA; international (where SMS is unreliable)
moat_note: Voice OTP with carrier attestation can't be SIM-swap intercepted via SMS.

name: Detect Recent IMEI Change
blocker: EIR change log access at partner carrier
mech: Queries the equipment registry for the last time the device IMEI changed. Cross-references provisioning records to determine if the customer initiated it. Escalates risk if combined with a recent SIM swap.
uses: Banking high-value gate; account recovery; crypto withdrawal
moat_note: EIR change log is carrier-internal.

name: Line Age as Trust Signal
mech: Returns how long the number has been on the carrier (and original activation if ported in). Freshly-activated numbers are statistically much higher fraud risk.
uses: Account opening; lending; fraud baselining
moat_note: BSS provisioning history is carrier-only.

name: Number Recycling Check
blocker: Authoritative reassignment data from partner carrier
mech: Checks whether a phone number has been reassigned to a new subscriber since a given date. Critical for TCPA compliance and preventing wrong-recipient transactions.
uses: TCPA compliance; account-takeover prevention; do-not-call list hygiene
moat_note: Authoritative reassignment data is carrier-only.

name: Detect Call Forwarding
mech: Queries the subscriber registry to see if call forwarding is active on the number. Recently-enabled forwarding is a strong scam indicator. Can block high-value calls if forwarding is active.
uses: Banking fraud gate; account takeover detection
moat_note: HSS forwarding flags are carrier registry. Apps can't see them.

name: Drop Attack Traffic at SBC
blocker: SBC blackhole rule API at partner
mech: Drops attack traffic at the carrier's session border controller before it reaches the subscriber. Logs the attack pattern so the network learns and protects other subscribers.
uses: Telephony DoS attack mitigation; targeted harassment campaigns
moat_note: SBC-level blackhole is carrier infrastructure.

name: Lawful Intercept
mech: Provides regulated lawful intercept capability for law enforcement under court order. Strict warrant-bound authorization with full audit trail. Captures voice, messaging, and data per warrant scope.
uses: Law enforcement compliance (regulatory requirement)
moat_note: Lawful intercept is carrier obligation; only carriers can do it legally.

name: Per-App Network ACL
blocker: AAA policy API at partner carrier
mech: Installs a network-level access policy that blocks or allows specific apps and destinations for the subscriber. Enforced at the user plane, not on the device.
uses: Corporate device policy; parental controls; addiction recovery
moat_note: Network-level ACL survives device wipe.

name: DPI-Based Redirect
blocker: DPI/UPF rule API at partner carrier
mech: Uses deep packet inspection at the user plane to match suspicious traffic patterns and redirect to a captive portal (e.g., warning page or quarantine). Notifies the subscriber.
uses: Phishing-domain interception; malware C2 blocking
moat_note: DPI at UPF is carrier core. App-layer DNS filters can be bypassed.

name: Network Attach Type
mech: Returns the subscriber's current radio attachment type (5G, 4G, 3G, Wi-Fi calling). Determines what slicing and HD-voice features are available right now.
uses: Adaptive UX for app capability; coverage diagnostics; 5G upsell
moat_note: Real-time RAN attach is carrier signaling.

name: Wake Idle Device
blocker: NEF device-triggering API at partner 5G core
mech: Wakes a device from idle without needing push-notification infrastructure (Apple/Google). Bound to subscriber and app identity. Delivers a small payload via low-power signaling.
uses: IoT wakeup; cross-platform notifications without APNs/FCM; low-power devices
moat_note: NEF device-triggering is 5G core. Bypasses Apple/Google push monopolies.

name: Carrier WebRTC Bridge
mech: Bridges a browser-based WebRTC call to the PSTN, presenting the subscriber's verified identity. Adds a QoS slice for HD audio. Useful for click-to-call from web apps with carrier-grade trust.
uses: Click-to-call from web; remote workforce; tele-medicine
moat_note: Carrier WebRTC gateway with attestation: WebRTC-only providers can't sign STIR/SHAKEN.
